text:
releasebot: Hotfix scheduled: embed-backpressure-fix -> canary. Window 04:15-04:30 UTC. Cause: transient embed queue overload causing 503s. pinging @oncall SRE.

anika: oncall here. request expedited path — if canary shows stable for 90s with no errors we want permission to cut fast to 30% to reduce user impact.

ryan: eng +1. Patch is pure api-layer backpressure tweak, image pinned to sha: z9y8x7w6. No schema changes.

sre_tom: stand by. Abort conditions: error-rate > 0.7% for two consecutive minutes OR p99 > 280ms. Keep EU traffic on stable for now.

anika: ops checklist:
```
- deploybot deploy --env=canary --image=redwood/hotfix:z9y8x7w6
- healthchecks x3 30s apart
- monitors: embed-queue-length, embeddings-503
- rollback: deploybot rollback --to-sha=prev-77aa
```

opsbot: preflight OK: image exists, infra quotas OK, node ready count healthy.

deploybot: Canary started on 2 hosts (sha z9y8x7w6). Opening ephemeral alert channel.

sre_tom: observing metrics.

opsbot: canary minute 1: errors 0.3%, p99 110ms. minute 2: errors 0.2%, p99 115ms. Burn-in passes.

anika: proceeding fastcut to 30% traffic; pin image across rollout.

opsbot: post-cut checks: 2m average errors 0.25%, p99 130ms. No alerts. Monitoring 8m.

ryan: noted. will tag final release once stable. Release note draft: "hotfix: reduce embed backpressure, prevent transient 503s under load; pinned z9y8x7w6."

opsbot: 8m observation complete: errors steady 0.18%, p99 135ms, no pages.

sre_tom: EU still on stable, will approve final cut once EU metrics look ok for 5m.

anika: thanks—closing ephemeral channel in 5. If anything fires i'll post here and run rollback. :white_check_mark:
